patient_brief.mechanism: crushed by scaffolding, brief LOC at scene

actions_required: Prepare for advanced airway intervention if there is any deterioration.
Insert a chest tube on the right side now.
Consider supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 >90%.
Be prepared for pericardiocentesis if hemodynamic instability develops.
Consider head CT if there is any decline in mental status.
Fully undress the patient for a complete physical examination.
Assess for any other injuries that might have been missed.

recommended_actions.action: Admit to ICU for close monitoring and management.
recommended_actions.rationale: Patient has a significant pneumothorax and was involved in a high-energy trauma.
